payload.question: How many keys does a standard modern piano have?
payload.comparison: Of those keys, 52 are white; the rest are black.

reveal.context: Modern pianos have a row of 88 black and white keys: 52 white keys and 36 black keys. The invention of the piano is credited to Bartolomeo Cristofori of Padua, Italy; an inventory made by his employers, the Medici family, shows that a piano existed by 1700.

sources.excerpt: Modern pianos have a row of 88 black and white keys: 52 white keys and 36 black keys, for a total of 88 keys. The invention of the piano is credited to Bartolomeo Cristofori of Padua, Italy. An inventory made by his employers, the Medici family, indicates the existence of a piano by 1700.
